summary: Further community.aws changes: ec2_vpc_peer, ec2_vpc_peering_info, ec2_vpc_vgw(_info), ec2_vpc_vpn(_info) and elb_classic_lb_info moved to amazon.aws. ecs_cluster purge_capacity_providers now defaults to true, and the iam_policy connection_properties return key was removed.
questions: Why did ecs_cluster remove my capacity providers?
What's the FQCN for elb_classic_lb_info now?

answer_card.title: VPC peering/VPN modules moved and ecs_cluster default
answer_card.answer_md:
- Moved to amazon.aws: `ec2_vpc_peer`, `ec2_vpc_peering_info`, `ec2_vpc_vgw`, `ec2_vpc_vgw_info`, `ec2_vpc_vpn`, `ec2_vpc_vpn_info`, `elb_classic_lb_info`.
- `ecs_cluster`: `purge_capacity_providers` now defaults to `true`. Set it to `false` to keep unlisted providers.
- The `connection_properties` return key was removed. Use `raw_connection_properties`.
